description: Search current vacancies in the Netherlands by job and place. Returns the total found and a list of vacancies, each with its key (for get-vacancy), employer slug (for get-employer) and URL.

employment_type.description: Employment type slug, e.g. "fulltime", "parttime" or "tijdelijk". Optional.

limit.description: Number of vacancies to return, 1-20. Defaults to 10.

posted_within_days.description: Only vacancies published within this many days, 1-365. Optional.

what.description: Job title or keyword, e.g. "verpleegkundige". Optional.

where.description: City, province or other place in the Netherlands, e.g. "Utrecht". Optional.

name: search-vacancies
title: Search vacancies
